reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that provides a draggable floating dashboard for real-time local system performance metrics, with optional process-network and GPU sampling.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可拖动、可折叠的系统性能悬浮看板，实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、运行时长及可用的 GPU 指标。
summaries.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds a draggable, collapsible floating dashboard for real-time CPU, memory, disk, network, load, uptime, and available GPU metrics.

capabilities: Collects local CPU, memory, disk, network, load, uptime, and supported GPU metrics
Reads Linux system interfaces including /proc and statfs
Samples current-user process network information via ss when available
Optionally invokes nvidia-smi for NVIDIA GPU metrics
Exposes collected metrics through a same-origin HTTP snapshot route
Stores widget position and visibility in browser localStorage
